rationale: Severity ranked by maximum post-outage branch loading relative to rating. out_l12 overloads l13 to 88/70=125.7% (>100% threshold), so it is the only overload-critical outage and ranks first. Remaining outages are ranked by their max loading: out_l13 (l12=99/100=99%), out_l23 (l12=91/100=91%), out_l34 (l12=80/100=80%). Only l34 is a bridge branch connecting bus b4 (degree 1) to the rest of the network, so its outage islands b4 and is flagged true; all other branches lie on cycles and do not island the network.
